title: MyCity chatbot policy answers
system: New York City MyCity business chatbot
organization: The Markup; New York City Office of Technology and Innovation referenced

cells.title: Source
body: The Markup published direct tests of New York City's MyCity chatbot on March 29, 2024.
The article included screenshots and examples of answers given to business-policy questions.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The chatbot gave answers that The Markup reported as contrary to New York City law or policy.
The city left the chatbot online while adding warnings that answers could be inaccurate.

cells.output: The Markup reported that the chatbot told businesses some actions were permitted even when those actions would violate local rules.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary artifact for this file is The Markup's direct testing record.
Verification is marked primary with gaps because the archive has the published tests but not server logs from MyCity.
